known_outcomes.name: member_not_found
known_outcomes.description: The searched member id / name matched no record. A legitimate answer the caller must handle, not an error.

known_outcomes.name: permission_denied
known_outcomes.description: The member is flagged restricted / the operator lacks rights. A business outcome: the caller may need a supervisor override.

recovery.name: session_timeout
recovery.description: Session expired mid-flow -> bounced to the login screen. Re-authenticate and retry the step.

recovery.name: maintenance_notice
recovery.description: An unscheduled 'system notice' interstitial. Acknowledge it and carry on.

recovery.name: transient_slow_load
recovery.description: A screen that has not finished rendering its expected content yet. Wait once and re-check before failing.
